sentences.en: What is the percentage of overseas markets for your products?
sentences.zh: 你们的产品在国外市场的占比是多少？

sentences.en: Overseas food exports are one of the mainstays of agribusiness.
sentences.zh: 农产品出口到国外是农业企业的主要收入来源之一。

sentences.en: The number of students going overseas has been increasing lately.
sentences.zh: 最近去国外留学的学生人数一直在增加。

senses.zh: 海外，国外（尤指欧洲以外的国家）
